# @plurid/uitive-planner

<!-- Generated by `pnpm docs` from packages/planner/src: edit the JSDoc there. -->

The model planner, for any provider: contracts compiled to structured outputs, the prompt, and models from Anthropic, OpenAI and every server that speaks its API, Gemini, or your own. It runs on servers and in extensions.

Install: `pnpm add @plurid/uitive-planner`, with `@anthropic-ai/sdk` ^0.131.0, `zod` ^4.2.0 as peers. Guides: [Planning](../planning.md).

- [The model planner](#the-model-planner): [`modelPlanner`](#modelplanner), [`repairText`](#repairtext), [`toOperations`](#tooperations), [`ModelPlannerOptions`](#modelplanneroptions), [`PlannerOutput`](#planneroutput)
- [Models](#models): [`anthropic`](#anthropic), [`costOf`](#costof), [`DEFAULT_MODELS`](#default_models), [`environmentModel`](#environmentmodel), [`google`](#google), [`openai`](#openai), [`PlannerError`](#plannererror), [`AnthropicOptions`](#anthropicoptions), [`GoogleOptions`](#googleoptions), [`Model`](#model), [`ModelCall`](#modelcall), [`ModelMessage`](#modelmessage), [`ModelPrices`](#modelprices), [`ModelReply`](#modelreply), [`ModelUsage`](#modelusage), [`OpenAIOptions`](#openaioptions)
- [`@plurid/uitive-planner/schema`](#pluriduitive-plannerschema): [`limits`](#limits), [`outputSchema`](#outputschema), [`size`](#size), [`vocabulary`](#vocabulary), [`SchemaOptions`](#schemaoptions), [`Vocabulary`](#vocabulary-type)
- [`@plurid/uitive-planner/prompt`](#pluriduitive-plannerprompt): [`contractText`](#contracttext), [`requestText`](#requesttext), [`RULES`](#rules)

## The model planner

Source: [`output.ts`](../../packages/planner/src/output.ts), [`plan.ts`](../../packages/planner/src/plan.ts)

### modelPlanner

Plans with a language model from any provider. The contract compiles to the schema the answer
must follow, so a model that keeps to it can only name what the application offers; answers are
checked against it all the same. Large contracts are first scoped to the areas a request needs,
and each scope's schema and prompt are prepared once, so providers' caches stay warm. An answer
that strays from the schema, or that policy would partly reject, goes back once for repair.

```ts
function modelPlanner(options: ModelPlannerOptions): Planner;
```

Also exported by `@plurid/uitive-server`.

Uses: [`ModelPlannerOptions`](#modelplanneroptions), [`Planner`](core.md#planner).

### repairText

What policy rejected, for the model to repair.

```ts
function repairText(rejected: readonly OutputRejection[]): string;
```

Also exported by `@plurid/uitive-server`.

Uses: [`OutputRejection`](core.md#outputrejection).

### toOperations

Turns the model's flat output into proposed operations for policy to check.

```ts
function toOperations(output: PlannerOutput): ProposedOperation[];
```

Also exported by `@plurid/uitive-server`.

Uses: [`PlannerOutput`](#planneroutput), [`ProposedOperation`](core.md#proposedoperation).

### ModelPlannerOptions

How `modelPlanner` plans: with which model, and how much it may write.

Also exported by `@plurid/uitive-server`.

Uses: [`Model`](#model).

| Property     | Type     | Default | Description                                                                                                                                  |
| ------------ | -------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `model`      | `Model`  |         | The model that plans, such as `anthropic()`, `openai({ model: 'gpt-6.1-sol' })`, `google({ model: 'gemini-3.8-flash' })` or one of your own. |
| `maxTokens?` | `number` | `16000` | Most tokens the model may write, thinking included.                                                                                          |

### PlannerOutput

What the model writes, in the schema `outputSchema` compiles: a status, candidates for ambiguous
requests, a note and flat operations. Policy checks it after `toOperations`.

```ts
interface PlannerOutput {
  status: 'done' | 'ambiguous' | 'unsupported';
  candidates: string[];
  note: string;
  lists?: {
    surface: string;
    context: string;
    op: 'promote' | 'demote' | 'move' | 'pin' | 'unpin' | 'hide' | 'restore';
    target: string;
    index: number;
    basis: 'request' | 'goal' | 'usage';
    metric: 'none' | Metric;
  }[];
  choices?: {
    surface: string;
    value: string;
    basis: 'request' | 'goal' | 'usage';
  }[];
  pages?: {
    surface: string;
    context: string;
    op: 'set' | 'reset' | 'create' | 'rename' | 'delete';
    slug?: string;
    title?: string;
    root: string;
    elements: {
      id: string;
      block: string;
      props: unknown;
      children: string[];
    }[];
    data?: {
      name: string;
      query: unknown;
    }[];
    basis: 'request' | 'goal' | 'usage';
  }[];
}
```

Also exported by `@plurid/uitive-server`.

Uses: [`Metric`](core.md#metric).

| Property     | Description                                                                         |
| ------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `status`     | Whether the model answered the request, found it ambiguous, or couldn't answer it.  |
| `candidates` | For an ambiguous request: what the words could mean.                                |
| `note`       | A short note for the person, shown with the changes.                                |
| `lists?`     | Changes to lists, each with what it is based on.                                    |
| `choices?`   | Values for choices, each with what it is based on.                                  |
| `pages?`     | Pages to redesign, reset, or, for the person's own pages, create, rename or delete. |

## Models

Source: [`anthropic.ts`](../../packages/planner/src/anthropic.ts), [`environment.ts`](../../packages/planner/src/environment.ts), [`google.ts`](../../packages/planner/src/google.ts), [`model.ts`](../../packages/planner/src/model.ts), [`openai.ts`](../../packages/planner/src/openai.ts)

### anthropic

Claude, through Anthropic's structured outputs: the provider constrains every answer to the
schema. The rules and the contract are marked for prompt caching, so repeated requests about one
contract read them from the cache. Needs `@anthropic-ai/sdk`, loaded only when a call is made.

```ts
function anthropic(options?: AnthropicOptions): Model;
```

Also exported by `@plurid/uitive-server`.

Uses: [`AnthropicOptions`](#anthropicoptions), [`Model`](#model).

### costOf

What a call cost in US dollars, from its usage and the model's prices.

```ts
function costOf(usage: ModelUsage, prices: ModelPrices | undefined): number | undefined;
```

Also exported by `@plurid/uitive-server`.

Uses: [`ModelPrices`](#modelprices), [`ModelUsage`](#modelusage).

### DEFAULT_MODELS

The model each provider plans with when `UITIVE_MODEL` names none.

```ts
const DEFAULT_MODELS: {
  readonly anthropic: 'claude-opus-5-5';
  readonly openai: 'gpt-6.1-sol';
  readonly google: 'gemini-3.8-flash';
};
```

Also exported by `@plurid/uitive-server`.

### environmentModel

The model whose key the environment holds, so a server plans with whichever provider it has a key
for: Anthropic (`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`), else OpenAI (`OPENAI_API_KEY`), else Gemini
(`GEMINI_API_KEY` or `GOOGLE_API_KEY`). `UITIVE_MODEL` names the model, else each provider's
default. Without a key, nothing, for the deterministic planner to take over. Runtimes without a
process environment, such as Cloudflare Workers, pass their own variables.

```ts
function environmentModel(
  variables?: Readonly<Record<string, string | undefined>>,
): Model | undefined;
```

Also exported by `@plurid/uitive-server`.

Uses: [`Model`](#model).

### google

Gemini, through the Gemini API's structured output: the provider constrains each answer to the
schema (`responseJsonSchema`). The rules and the contract lead every call unchanged, which
Gemini's implicit caching rewards. Calls `fetch`: no SDK.

```ts
function google(options: GoogleOptions): Model;
```

Also exported by `@plurid/uitive-server`.

Uses: [`GoogleOptions`](#googleoptions), [`Model`](#model).

### openai

A model behind OpenAI's Chat Completions API: OpenAI's own, or any compatible server, such as
Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio, OpenRouter or Groq. Uses structured outputs (strict JSON Schema) by
default; `structured: 'json'` or `'text'` suits servers without them. Calls `fetch`: no SDK.

```ts
function openai(options: OpenAIOptions): Model;
```

Also exported by `@plurid/uitive-server`.

Uses: [`Model`](#model), [`OpenAIOptions`](#openaioptions).

### PlannerError

A planner failure, with the HTTP status the handler answers with.

```ts
class PlannerError extends Error {
  readonly status: number;
  readonly reason?: 'too-complex' | undefined;
  constructor(message: string, status: number, reason?: 'too-complex' | undefined);
}
```

Also exported by `@plurid/uitive-server`.

### AnthropicOptions

How `anthropic()` calls Claude: which model, how hard it thinks, how long it may take, and with
which key or client.

Also exported by `@plurid/uitive-server`.

| Property     | Type                                              | Default                                                                    | Description                                                                                |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `model?`     | `string`                                          | `'claude-opus-5-5'`                                                        | The model.                                                                                 |
| `effort?`    | `'low' \| 'medium' \| 'high' \| 'xhigh' \| 'max'` | `'low'`                                                                    | How much the model thinks before answering; `low` keeps commands quick.                    |
| `timeoutMs?` | `number`                                          | `60000`                                                                    | How long a call may take before it fails.                                                  |
| `fallbacks?` | `boolean`                                         | `true`                                                                     | Server-side refusal fallback (beta `server-side-fallback-2026-07-01`).                     |
| `apiKey?`    | `string`                                          |                                                                            | The API key, where there is no environment to read it from, such as in Cloudflare Workers. |
| `client?`    | `Pick<Anthropic, 'beta'>`                         | one from the environment: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or an `ant auth login` profile | The Anthropic client, such as one made for a browser extension's worker.                   |

### GoogleOptions

How `google()` calls Gemini: which model, with which key, and how it keeps to the schema.

Also exported by `@plurid/uitive-server`.

Uses: [`FetchLike`](core.md#fetchlike), [`ModelPrices`](#modelprices).

| Property          | Type                           | Default                                                   | Description                                                                                                                           |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `model`           | `string`                       |                                                           | The model, such as `gemini-3.8-flash`.                                                                                                |
| `apiKey?`         | `string`                       | GEMINI_API_KEY, else GOOGLE_API_KEY, from the environment | The API key.                                                                                                                          |
| `baseURL?`        | `string`                       | `'https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta'`      | The API's base URL.                                                                                                                   |
| `structured?`     | `'schema' \| 'json' \| 'text'` | `'schema'`                                                | How the model keeps to the schema: `schema` for structured output, `json` for JSON with the schema in the prompt, `text` for neither. |
| `thinkingBudget?` | `number`                       |                                                           | Most tokens the model may spend thinking, for models that think.                                                                      |
| `timeoutMs?`      | `number`                       | `60000`                                                   | How long a call may take before it fails.                                                                                             |
| `prices?`         | `ModelPrices`                  |                                                           | US dollars per million tokens, to report what plans cost.                                                                             |
| `fetch?`          | `FetchLike`                    | `globalThis.fetch`                                        | The `fetch` it calls.                                                                                                                 |

### Model

A language model that plans, from any provider: `anthropic()`, `openai()` for OpenAI and every
server that speaks its API, `google()`, or one of your own.

Also exported by `@plurid/uitive-server`.

Uses: [`ModelCall`](#modelcall), [`ModelReply`](#modelreply).

| Property     | Type                                       | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `provider`   | `string`                                   | The provider, as plan results report it, such as `openai`.                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `name`       | `string`                                   | The model's name, such as `gpt-6.1-sol`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `structured` | `'schema' \| 'json' \| 'text'`             | How the model keeps to the schema. `schema`: the provider constrains the answer to it. `json`: the answer is JSON, and the schema goes in the prompt. `text`: neither. Answers are checked against the schema either way, and repaired once when they stray. |
| `generate()` | `(call: ModelCall) => Promise<ModelReply>` | Calls the model; failures throw a `PlannerError` with the status the handler answers.                                                                                                                                                                        |

### ModelCall

What one call to a model takes: instructions, the conversation, the schema and its limits.

Also exported by `@plurid/uitive-server`.

Uses: [`ModelMessage`](#modelmessage).

| Property    | Type                         | Description                                                                           |
| ----------- | ---------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `rules`     | `string`                     | The planner's rules: the same for every call.                                         |
| `contract`  | `string`                     | The contract as text: the same for every request about it, so providers can cache it. |
| `messages`  | `readonly ModelMessage[]`    | The conversation so far.                                                              |
| `schema`    | `Record<string, unknown>`    | The JSON Schema the answer must follow, as `outputSchema` compiles it.                |
| `maxTokens` | `number`                     | Most tokens the model may write, thinking included.                                   |
| `signal?`   | `unknown`                    | An `AbortSignal` that cancels the call, such as when the person leaves.               |
| `onText?`   | `(snapshot: string) => void` | Hears the answer so far, as it streams.                                               |

### ModelMessage

One message of a planning conversation: the request, and for a repair, the answer and what to fix.

Also exported by `@plurid/uitive-server`.

| Property  | Type                    | Description   |
| --------- | ----------------------- | ------------- |
| `role`    | `'user' \| 'assistant'` | Who wrote it. |
| `content` | `string`                | What it says. |

### ModelPrices

US dollars per million tokens, for reporting what plans cost.

Also exported by `@plurid/uitive-server`.

| Property      | Type     | Default | Description                  |
| ------------- | -------- | ------- | ---------------------------- |
| `input`       | `number` |         | Tokens read.                 |
| `output`      | `number` |         | Tokens written.              |
| `cacheRead?`  | `number` | `input` | Tokens read from the cache.  |
| `cacheWrite?` | `number` | `input` | Tokens written to the cache. |

### ModelReply

What a model answered, how it stopped, and what it used.

Also exported by `@plurid/uitive-server`.

Uses: [`ModelUsage`](#modelusage).

| Property | Type                           | Description                                                                     |
| -------- | ------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `text`   | `string`                       | The answer as text: JSON, when the model kept to the schema.                    |
| `stop`   | `'done' \| 'refused' \| 'cut'` | `refused` when the model declined, `cut` when it ran out of tokens.             |
| `model`  | `string`                       | The model that answered, which may differ from the one asked, after a fallback. |
| `usage`  | `ModelUsage`                   | Tokens used.                                                                    |
| `cost?`  | `number`                       | What the call cost in US dollars, when the model's prices are known.            |

### ModelUsage

Tokens a call used.

Also exported by `@plurid/uitive-server`.

| Property     | Type     | Description                                    |
| ------------ | -------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `input`      | `number` | Tokens read, besides those from the cache.     |
| `output`     | `number` | Tokens written, thinking included.             |
| `cacheRead`  | `number` | Tokens read from the provider's prompt cache.  |
| `cacheWrite` | `number` | Tokens written to the provider's prompt cache. |

### OpenAIOptions

How `openai()` calls a model through OpenAI's Chat Completions API, which many providers and
local servers speak too: which model, where, with which key, and how it keeps to the schema.

Also exported by `@plurid/uitive-server`.

Uses: [`FetchLike`](core.md#fetchlike), [`ModelPrices`](#modelprices).

| Property           | Type                                       | Default                                                   | Description                                                                                                                                 |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `model`            | `string`                                   |                                                           | The model, such as `gpt-6.1-sol`, or one a compatible server offers, such as `qwen3` on Ollama.                                             |
| `apiKey?`          | `string`                                   | OPENAI_API_KEY from the environment, for OpenAI's own API | The API key.                                                                                                                                |
| `baseURL?`         | `string`                                   | `'https://api.openai.com/v1'`                             | The API's base URL, for compatible servers: `http://localhost:11434/v1` for Ollama, `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1` for OpenRouter.          |
| `headers?`         | `Readonly<Record<string, string>>`         |                                                           | Headers sent with every call, such as a provider's own.                                                                                     |
| `structured?`      | `'schema' \| 'json' \| 'text'`             | `'schema'`                                                | How the model keeps to the schema: `schema` for structured outputs, `json` for JSON mode with the schema in the prompt, `text` for neither. |
| `reasoningEffort?` | `'minimal' \| 'low' \| 'medium' \| 'high'` |                                                           | How much a reasoning model thinks before answering, where the model takes it.                                                               |
| `timeoutMs?`       | `number`                                   | `60000`                                                   | How long a call may take before it fails.                                                                                                   |
| `prices?`          | `ModelPrices`                              |                                                           | US dollars per million tokens, to report what plans cost.                                                                                   |
| `fetch?`           | `FetchLike`                                | `globalThis.fetch`                                        | The `fetch` it calls.                                                                                                                       |

## `@plurid/uitive-planner/schema`

Source: [`schema.ts`](../../packages/planner/src/schema.ts)

### limits

Counts what structured outputs limit per request: optional and union-typed parameters.

```ts
function limits(schema: unknown): {
  optional: number;
  unions: number;
};
```

Also exported by `@plurid/uitive-planner/schema`, `@plurid/uitive-server`.

### outputSchema

Compiles a contract into the one structured-output schema every call uses: flat operation
lists with every field required and explicit `none` sentinels, shared enums under `$defs`,
and pages as flat elements that name their children, since grammars can't recurse.
One schema per contract means one compiled grammar and one warm prompt cache.

```ts
function outputSchema(contract: AnyContract, options?: SchemaOptions): Record<string, unknown>;
```

Also exported by `@plurid/uitive-planner/schema`, `@plurid/uitive-server`.

Uses: [`AnyContract`](core.md#anycontract), [`SchemaOptions`](#schemaoptions).

### size

How big a schema is: its bytes, and its largest enum, which grammars pay for most.

```ts
function size(schema: unknown): {
  bytes: number;
  largestEnum: number;
};
```

Also exported by `@plurid/uitive-planner/schema`, `@plurid/uitive-server`.

### vocabulary

Every value a planner may emit for a contract, lower-cased once: action IDs, surfaces by kind,
contexts and choice values.

```ts
function vocabulary(contract: AnyContract): Vocabulary;
```

Also exported by `@plurid/uitive-planner/schema`, `@plurid/uitive-server`.

Uses: [`AnyContract`](core.md#anycontract), [`Vocabulary`](#vocabulary-type).

### SchemaOptions

What part of a contract a schema covers.

Also exported by `@plurid/uitive-planner/schema`, `@plurid/uitive-server`.

Uses: [`Subset`](core.md#subset).

| Property  | Type      | Default | Description                                                                    |
| --------- | --------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `subset?` | `Subset`  |         | Scopes sources, and the actions that act on them, to part of a large contract. |
| `native?` | `boolean` | `true`  | Whether the application's own blocks are offered.                              |

### Vocabulary type

The enum values a planner may emit for actions, contexts and the like, lower-cased once.

Also exported by `@plurid/uitive-planner/schema`, `@plurid/uitive-server`.

| Property   | Type       | Description                 |
| ---------- | ---------- | --------------------------- |
| `lists`    | `string[]` | The lists' surface names.   |
| `choices`  | `string[]` | The choices' surface names. |
| `pages`    | `string[]` | The pages' surface names.   |
| `actions`  | `string[]` | Every action ID.            |
| `contexts` | `string[]` | Every context value.        |
| `values`   | `string[]` | Every choice value.         |
| `regions`  | `string[]` | Every region name.          |

## `@plurid/uitive-planner/prompt`

Source: [`prompt.ts`](../../packages/planner/src/prompt.ts)

### contractText

The application's contract as text: stable across users, so it caches. For large contracts,
a subset scopes the sources described to those chosen for the request.

```ts
function contractText(contract: AnyContract, subset?: Subset): string;
```

Also exported by `@plurid/uitive-planner/prompt`, `@plurid/uitive-server`.

Uses: [`AnyContract`](core.md#anycontract), [`Subset`](core.md#subset).

### requestText

The part of every request that changes: what was asked, what is on screen, how it is used.

```ts
function requestText(request: PlanRequest): string;
```

Also exported by `@plurid/uitive-planner/prompt`, `@plurid/uitive-server`.

Uses: [`PlanRequest`](core.md#planrequest).

### RULES

The frozen part of every request: how to work.

```ts
const RULES: string;
```

Also exported by `@plurid/uitive-planner/prompt`, `@plurid/uitive-server`.
